title: Great name/Flimsy product
text:
Great name/Flimsy product. With the Krups name, one would expect a quality product. Not so with the GVX1 Burr Coffee Grinder. The unit works well for pour over grinds, but coarser grinds are inconsistent. The collection bin is a static nightmare, but that's what you get with the type of plastic used. The collection bin tends to become unseated during grinding due to vibration -- an annoyance but not the end of the world.

After 6 months the power on/off button disappeared inside the unit. The spring had become unseated from the button when the post on the button cracked off. The one most-used mechanical part (aside from the grinder) is a cheap piece of plastic. When I called about a repair, the shipping was going to cost more than the unit was worth (and a MINIMUM of 10 working days to complete the repairs). I never spoke to a human being either when I called KrupsUSA or their authorized repair center in my area.

Being stubborn, I jury rigged an on/off button so I can at least grind my coffee (and my teeth) while I hunt down a unit under $150.00 with better reviews.

I would not recommend this unit if you plan to grind coffee more than 2-3 times/day

product_metadata.title: KRUPS GVX1-14 Coffee Grinder with Grid Size and Cup Selection and Stainless Steel Conical Burr, Black
features: Anti-static bean container with lid holds up to 8 oz of ground coffee, avoids overheating and preserves aroma
Quantity selector for 2 to 12 cups, fineness selector of 17 different settings
Measures 10 by 4-1/2 by 5-1/2 inches; 2-year worldwide limited warranty
description: Krups GVX1-14 Burr Grinder, Black. Grinding beans just before brewing ensures the best flavor. The best method of grinding is with a Krups burr grinder which produces a highly controllable texture without overheating the beans, 17 position fineness select

This smartly designed, finely tunable burr coffee grinder from Krups is built on the premise that good coffee starts with the freshest, most appropriate grind. Equipped with an expert-quality burr milling system, the machine turns out very consistent grounds with minimal heat for the best-tasting coffee. Its coarseness dial offers 17 distinct settings to create precisely the right grind for the occasion, brewing method, and kind of bean. In addition, the quantity dial, ranging from 2 to 12 cups, lets you grind no more coffee than you need, which helps preserve fresh aroma and flavor.

Structurally handsome and easy to use, the grinder features a large transparent bean hopper with a clearly marked "max" line. The grounds container, also transparent, is lidded and removable for tidy transport to the espresso machine or French press. Simple maintenance is also a boon here--the burr removes for easy cleanup and Krups includes a cleaning brush for the hopper. Shiny and matte black with silver accents, the grinder looks dashing on the countertop without drawing excess attention to itself. It stands 10-1/2 by 4-3/4 by 5-3/4 inches and carries a one-year warranty.
